notes.title: Update Node 2.0.0
notes.content:
1. Tags in Workshop is now activated and RESOURCE TYPE tag is added to the mix. You can find the resources MOD under that tag. 
2. Deleted the "Shop" function in the editor so that you don't have to buy those first anymore. 
3. More space for improvization. You now can choose what skill to use for Lv2 and Lv3 gems. 
4. Added Match-3 Battle editing function. 
You can make your own battle phase from now on. 
5. New Resource Mod Type
You can now create resources MOD, which will open a folder for you to put everything you want to upload, please note that the quantity should be more than 1 but less than 1000. 
6. Regular bug fixes.

notes.title: Update V1.1.1
notes.content:
1. Partially open battle part for your to edit. You can now edit basic player data and basic enemy data. Enemy AI is not changable for the moment.
2. Now support 32-bit system.
3. Optimized the experience in windowed mode.
4. Optimized memory usage.
5. You can shift to the resource list according to the buttons below you click.

If you need instruction in the editor, please click the button on the top right cornor for help.

notes.title: Mirror Maker Update V1.0.1
notes.content:
1. Optimized UI, added hovering and clicking effects of some buttons. Importing official script is now more easier. 
2. Added cloud saves to all mods. 
3. Added copy function to right click menu of the paragraph. 
4. Fixed the delete button. 
5. Added a refresh button, so after you download mods from the workshop you don't need to restart the game. 

About future development: 
We're very sorry that the current version is not very big on functions. We just wanted to let you know what the core concept this editor would be but the content and function will definitely double or even triple in the final version. In the future, we'll: 
1. unlock battle scenes for modding, you can replace gems, icons, portraits and sound effects. 
2. add resource pack for you to use for free, there will be packs for art, music and etc for modding.
